description: START HERE when orienting on the trial corpus. Returns the total source-record count, the deduplicated canonical trial count, how many are currently active, the per-registry attribution, and the curated topic ids you can pass as `topic` to the other trial tools. Counts are never summed across registries — each registry's contribution is reported separately alongside the distinct total. NEXT: search_world_trials to query it, get_registry_sources for licence and sync freshness per registry.
name: get_trial_stats
